verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability documents its own visualization of queried metrics and prebuilt dashboards for diagnosing issues, so the product has a dashboard capability. The evidence never shows SREs building custom dashboards, sharing them, choosing among visualization types, or using template variables. missing for 10: evidence of authoring custom dashboards, sharing/permissions, a range of visualization types, template/dashboard variables, dashboards-as-code export or import, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: visualization with prebuilt dashboards to diagnose issues
Query them with ES|QL or Prometheus Query Language (PromQL), visualize them
